fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. You clamp on and roll: the bite deals 24 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and makes it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of Still Water
fusions.desc: You lunge up to 6 tiles to the target and bite. The bite deals 14 damage, with 50% more critical hit chance against an enemy that has not yet been wounded.

fusions.name: Sunk to the Eyes
fusions.desc: After 1.5 seconds held motionless, your damage is increased by 35% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: The Long Wait
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
